summary: The test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly but has weaknesses in selector specificity and assertion strength. The test title does not preserve the testCaseId 'TC-001'. The navigation assertion verifying the product detail page is too generic, relying only on a regex match on the URL, which could lead to false positives. There are no additional assertions verifying the product details which reduces the confidence in test coverage. No critical errors were found that would cause test failure.

issues.description: Selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is hardcoded and may not be robust if product IDs change. No context provided for the selector's stability.
issues.recommendation: Use more descriptive or data-driven selectors if possible or add a helper function to handle product selection dynamically.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a generic regex '/product/' which may not uniquely verify that a specific product detail page has loaded.
issues.recommendation: Enhance the URL assertion or add assertions on page content elements to confirm the specific product's presence.

issues.description: The test title does not include the testCaseId 'TC-001', reducing traceability between manual and automated test cases.
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in the test title to improve traceability.

recommendations: Include more robust assertions that verify product details on the page beyond URL checks.
Use parameterized or data-driven selectors to improve test flexibility and maintainability.
Add the testCaseId in the test name for traceability.
